moments.author: Angel Reese
moments.quote: Technical foul rescinded — staying at seven, available Sunday vs Lynx
moments.why: Her 8th tech would’ve triggered a suspension and fine; the WNBA rescinded it, keeping her in a pivotal playoff seeding game.

moments.author: Kyle Kirkwood
moments.quote: I never thought I'd race legal IndyCars around D.C. — what a moment.
moments.why: He went viral for winning the first-ever street IndyCar race around the National Mall, a patriotic spectacle ahead of all eyes this weekend.

moments.author: Josef Newgarden
moments.quote: This D.C. race may rival Indy 500 — capturing new fans for life.
moments.why: His comments on the historic street race in D.C. underscored its impact and amplified virality around the event.

moments.author: Bleacher Report
moments.quote: Angel Reese’s 8th technical rescinded, WNBA avoids suspension drama.
moments.why: Sports media amplified the news, spreading the viral reversal of her suspension across social feeds.
